_doc: OpenBuilds V-Slot 20x20 Linear Rail: a 20 x 20 mm rail with a V-Slot in each face, in 6063 T-5 aluminium, anodised clear or black. The size, the slot's opening and width, the bore and the pitch of the cells are printed on OpenBuilds' drawing; it publishes no area, second moments or mass that this build could read, so a beam's figures are worked out from the drawn outline. OpenBuilds shares its design work under CC BY-SA 4.0: dimensions are taken, the shape is not. The drawn outline leaves out the small V marks on the cores.
